attempts.text:
**The window starts at the cellulose synthase operon.** Column 0, `bcsF`, is a spine column carried by 100% of chromosomes, named in 99.6% of calls at 0.17 bits. Column 1, `bcsE`, is the most hesitant column of the window at 0.87 bits, and 99% of its calls are in a region of plasticity.

**Columns 2 to 4 mix spine and variable.** `bcsR` is a spine column at 91%, then `bcsQ` and `bcsA` are variable, 96 to 97% in a region of plasticity, with the fewest named calls at column 3, 85%. The long spine from columns 5 to 32, `bcsB` to `slp`, is carried by 90 to 96% of chromosomes and named in 94% of calls on average, but column 21, `gadX`, drops to 44%.

**A fork at column 33 carries a hypothetical protein** in 57% of chromosomes, then `arsC` is spine at 96%. Columns 35 and 36 are fork, `arsB` and `arsR`, named in 96% of calls. The spine resumes at columns 37 to 42, `dinQ` to `dtpB`, 95 to 96% carried.

**The window's plasticity fades toward the end.** Columns 53 to 79 are fork and variable columns, 14 to 24% in a region of plasticity, named in 92% of calls on average. The `nik` operon, [[nickel import]], runs through columns 58 to 63, and a parallel branch of 7 families through columns 57 to 63 carries [[sugar phosphotransferase transport]]. Across the window, inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 0.51 against 0.19 bits, and names fewer genes, 89% against 93%.

label: bcsF
facts:
WINDOW: the bcsF window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor bcsF, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 176 to 255 from dnaA. Read in 518 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying bcsF once); 41,440 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.27 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 29,714 calls, named 95%, 0.14 bits; shell 11,552 calls, named 85%, 0.58 bits; cloud 174 calls, named 8%, 2.03 bits. Outside an RGP 30,947 calls, named 93%, 0.19 bits; inside an RGP 10,493 calls, named 89%, 0.51 bits. Columns: 42 spine, 30 fork, 8 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.51 against 0.19 bits) and names fewer genes (89% against 93%); 10,493 of the 41,440 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 1 (bcsE) 0.87 bits, RGP 99%; column 3 (bcsQ) 0.75 bits, RGP 97%; column 4 (bcsA) 0.66 bits, RGP 96%. The 12 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 94%, 0.36 bits on average; the other 68 columns: named 92%, 0.25 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 1 (fork), RGP 99%; the least: columns 5-32 (spine), RGP 0-93%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 99%. Genes: bcsF "cellulose biosynthesis protein BcsF". named 99.6%; 0.17 bits.
2. column 1 fork: RGP 99%. named 85%; 0.87 bits.
   1: bcsE S 85%; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 31%
3. column 2 spine: share 91%, all S, RGP 99%. Genes: bcsR. named 91%; 0.39 bits.
4. columns 3-4 (2 columns) variable: RGP 96-97%. named 85-92% (mean 88%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 3, named 85%, 0.75 bits.
   3: bcsQ S 83%
   4: bcsA S 87%
5. columns 5-32 (28 columns) spine: share 90-96%, 26 P, 2 S, RGP 0-93%. Genes: bcsB, bcsZ, bcsC, hmsP, dctA, yhjJ "pitrilysin family protein", kdgK, pdeH, yhjG "AsmA family protein", yhjE "MFS transporter", yhjD "YhjD/YihY/BrkB family envelope inte…", rcdB, yhjB "response regulator transcription fa…", treF, ccp, gadA, gadX, gadW, mdtF "efflux RND transporter permease sub…", mdtE, "hypothetical protein", gadE, hdeD, hdeA, hdeB "acid-resistance protein", yhiD "MgtC/SapB family protein", dctR, slp. named 44-99% (mean 94%), fewest named at column 21 (gadX), named 44%; most hesitant at column 25 ("hypothetical protein"), 0.42 bits.
6. column 33 fork: RGP 48%. named 86%; 0.61 bits.
   33: "hypothetical protein" S 57%; also chuY S 33%
7. column 34 spine: share 96%, all P, RGP 51%. Genes: arsC. named 93%; 0.29 bits.
8. columns 35-36 (2 columns) fork: RGP 52%. named 96%; most hesitant at column 35, 0.20 bits.
   35: arsB S 82%; also hutW S 33%
   36: arsR S 83% "As(III)-sensing metalloregulatory t…"; also shuT S 34%
9. columns 37-42 (6 columns) spine: share 95-96%, all P, RGP 23-51%. Genes: dinQ, gorA, rlmJ, prlC, rsmJ, dtpB. named 89-97% (mean 94%), fewest named at column 41 (rsmJ), named 89%; most hesitant at column 42 (dtpB), 0.35 bits.
10. columns 43-44 (2 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 24%. named 92%; most hesitant at column 43, 0.37 bits.
   43 fork: "hypothetical protein" S 65%; also "ArsR/SmtB family transcription factor" S 36%
   44 variable: "hypothetical protein" S 45%
11. columns 45-48 (4 columns) spine: share 96%, all P, RGP 21-27%. Genes: uspA "universal stress protein UspA", uspB, pitA, yhiN. named 88-94% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 47 (pitA), named 88%; most hesitant at column 48 (yhiN), 0.40 bits.
12. columns 49-51 (3 columns) fork: RGP 21-22%. named 82-88% (mean 85%), fewest named at column 50, named 82%; most hesitant at column 49, 0.55 bits.
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 49-51, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 11-14%, all S; the branch's families: "TnsA endonuclease N-terminal domain-con…", "hypothetical protein", "NB-ARC domain-containing protein"
   49: yhiM S 88% "DUF2776 domain-containing protein"

13. column 52 spine: share 91%, all P, RGP 20%. Genes: yhiY "protein YhiY". named 87%; 0.49 bits.
14. columns 53-79 (27 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 14-24%. named 85-96% (mean 92%), fewest named at column 79, named 85%; most hesitant at column 53, 0.51 bits.
